method: Read the full chunk at each of the 10 source positions fixed in manual_review_template.json. Score 0 if a key idea is cut or its subject is missing, 1 if partly understandable but context is lost, 2 if the idea is self-contained. Retrieval scores were not used for these labels.
sample_rule: First five included pages per document, midpoint character on each page; the same positions for A, B and C.
possible_bias: The reviewer is an AI assistant and has seen the retrieval outputs; the student should inspect the linked PDF pages and confirm or correct each label before claiming a human audit.
